configurePresets.name: windows-clang
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x64: clang-cl, lld-link, static CRT, Release
configurePresets.description: From a vcvars64 environment (MSVC's headers and libraries, the Windows SDK, rc.exe) with LLVM's clang-cl 19 or newer on PATH; CMake takes lld-link and llvm-lib from clang-cl's folder. Pass the dependency prefix (SDL3, glslang, FFmpeg-XMA, all /MT): -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<prefix> -DFFMPEG_XMA=<prefix>.

configurePresets.name: windows-clang-tester
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x64 beta for testers: no console window, labelled
configurePresets.description: windows-clang for builds that go to testers (scripts/windows/make_zip.py): linked for the Windows subsystem (no console window; the session log has everything) and labelled, so logs, Settings > Advanced and bug-report names say 'SpeedBreaker v<version> Windows beta <date> (<commit>)'.
